name: gdscript-lsp-bridge
description: GDScript code intelligence for Claude Code, served by Godot's own built-in language server

plugins.name: gdscript-lsp
plugins.description: Go-to-definition, find-references, hover and document symbols for .gd files, from the GDScript language server built into the Godot editor binary. Requires Godot 4.x on PATH; no other dependencies.
